text:
[scroll-timeline-name]
type = "TimelineName"
initial = "computed::TimelineName::none()"
struct = "ui"
engine = "gecko"
vector = { need_index = true }
animation_type = "none"
gecko_pref = "layout.css.scroll-driven-animations.enabled"
spec = "https://drafts.csswg.org/scroll-animations-1/#scroll-timeline-name"
rule_types_allowed = ["style", "scope"]
affects = ""

[timeline-scope]
type = "ScopedName"
initial = "computed::ScopedName::none()"
struct = "ui"
engine = "gecko"
animation_type = "none"
gecko_pref = "layout.css.scroll-driven-animations.enabled"
spec = "https://drafts.csswg.org/scroll-animations-1/#timeline-scope"
affects = ""
